item.title: lxc: fix CVE-2026-100395
item.description:
Backport the two upstream fixes (lxc/lxc@6424a91, lxc/lxc@fa12709) as fetchpatches until a release contains them; drop them on the next version bump. Built on x86_64-linux, both patches apply cleanly and the test suite passes.

lxc-copy's hostname write followed a symlink preserved from the source rootfs, letting a privileged clone of an untrusted container truncate and overwrite an arbitrary host file.

Related to #584407 See https://github.com/lxc/lxc/security/advisories/GHSA-r23j-58gg-pjjc
